ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Day 18 of the cycle, trend intact above a rising 10-day average, weekly still mixed.
ladder.next: Hold; first warning would be losing the 10-day average, bigger warning is a daily momentum cross down.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed down; investor cycle overdue
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed down; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 28 · daily cycle day 18).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up
Daily momentum ~8 bars from turning up

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 18 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 18 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 28 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 28 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 周期第 18 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线仍为混合。
ladder.next_zh: 持有；首个预警是失守 10 日均线，更大的预警是日线动量向下交叉。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量刚刚向下交叉；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 28 周 · 日线周期第 18 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
日线动量距转为向上约 8 根 K 线
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A LOW). Signal strength: moderate (score +60/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近低点翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 +60/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+26）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Equinix Inc., is an American multinational internet and data center company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It specialized in internet connectivity and data center colocation centers, commonly known as carrier hotels, until the company converted to a real estate investment trust (REIT) in January 2015.
profile.description_zh: 易昆尼克斯公司是一家美国跨国互联网和数据中心企业，总部位于加利福尼亚州红木城。该公司专注于互联网连接和数据中心托管（通常称为运营商酒店），直至2015年1月转型为房地产投资信托基金。
